reviewed_by: Claude review of MCP import defaults and delta re-import
reason: POST /mcp-servers/import gains defaults {enabled, default_approval} for new servers and trust_local_programs, and on_conflict now defaults to update: an existing server is compared with the file and only differing settings are saved (connection fields from the file, Nebula-side settings kept unless the nebula block sets them, matching literal secrets reuse the stored credential, a trusted program whose command/args/env/cwd changed is untrusted and disabled unless trust is re-confirmed, connection changes clear probed tools). The CLI adds --enable, --approval, --trust-local-programs and --skip-existing. test_mcp_import.py covers defaults vs file precedence, unchanged/updated re-import with secret reuse and rotation, trust re-confirmation, and the API/CLI plumbing; test_operator_help.py checks the edited help article. The dialog (McpImportDialog.test.tsx), post-import auto-probe (HarnessSettings.test.tsx) and client mapping (client.test.ts) have unit coverage. area:mcp-import runs the real-Core journey on desktop, compact and Chromium/WebKit phones: first import, unchanged re-import, delta update with trust and enable-on-import with a real stdio probe. It also caught a real-browser bug fixed here: React reused the clicked Back button as the Preview submit button and re-submitted the form. The journey now checks Core readiness from Settings because phones hide the top bar on the Workbench since #355.
exclusions: No full suites. No native tests: no Tauri/Rust change. The new CSS is scoped to .mcp-import-* selectors, so no visual baselines or other dialogs are affected. Other Core API routes are untouched apart from the import request/report models.
